purpose: Define public-safe projection of merits, points, Tier, recommendations, trust and Project evidence with explicit privacy and provenance rules.

topics.name: Public Merit Projection
topics.purpose: Define public-safe projection of merits, points, Tier, recommendations, trust and Project evidence with explicit privacy and provenance rules.

semantics.source_rule: Projection reads exact accepted MeritCore evidence/evaluations.
semantics.tier_rule: Displayed Tier references exact current evaluation.
semantics.trust_rule: Trust projection remains derived evidence and includes profile/version metadata where useful.
semantics.source_truth_rule: Projection/cache is not canonical MeritCore source.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

references.purpose: Public projection references exact Tier evaluation.
